headline: Public hearing and decision on demolition delay application for 14 Summit Ave.
summary: A window rehabilitation project at the Beverly Golf & Tennis Club is up for a CPA application review. A Planning Board request for an open space site plan at 38 Standley Street is also on the agenda.
